Locals.adventure.main.title: Adventure
Locals.KEY_1: You find yourself in front of a tavern. The two-story dark-wood house stands slightly off the road, as if it had chosen its own quiet spot. A sign swings above the door: "Adventure Tavern." Smoke billows from the chimney, and a muffled hum of voices can be heard from beneath the threshold—not threatening, but homely.
